mapper.insert: INSERT INTO sys_notification (user_id, type, title, content, order_id, is_read, create_time) VALUES (#{userId}, #{type}, #{title}, #{content}, #{orderId}, 0, NOW())
mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM sys_notification WHERE user_id = #{userId} AND is_read = 0
mapper.update: UPDATE sys_notification SET is_read = 1 WHERE user_id = #{userId} AND order_id = #{orderId} AND is_read = 0
